MISSING GUARANTEE: no bounds validation of the endpoint array before indexing — code assumes altsetting s has at least k+1 endpoints and never checks altsetting[i].desc.bNumEndpoints > k, neither for altsetting[0] nor re-checked per iteration when looping over num_altsetting; same class includes indexing actconfig->interface[idx] without checking bNumInterfaces. UNSAFE USE: direct fixed-index descriptor reads at probe/bind/init (endpoint[k].desc.bEndpointAddress / .wMaxPacketSize) used to program pipes, and wMaxPacketSize used to compute and store per-altsetting max packet sizes (alt_max_pkt_size[]) that later size/limit URB transfer buffers. Transferable invariant: kernel code must validate an untrusted descriptor-declared length before using a device-model-assumed index into a descriptor array.
